reason: I get abayas on Amazon or TikTok Shop for $25 to $35 and wait for sales, so $45 for an everyday one, or $75 to $80 for a thobe, is more than I usually pay. On top of that, Westchase is a long drive from the Medical Center after a full workday just to look.
objection: I'd be paying boutique prices for styles that could be too Arab-specific or too plain for me, and I can't tell from this whether they carry anything that fits my look.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing actual photos of colorful or less traditional everyday pieces, plus a real sale bringing an everyday abaya down to about $30, maybe shipped or online so I don't have to drive out there.
